fields.body: Please install eight concrete barriers along the west apron. These are additional to our current package. I have asked the field crew to start setting out tomorrow. Submit the additional scope for review.

Eight west apron barriers are already included in the tender scope, detail C-21. The owner email refers to the same eight locations, not eight further units. Proceed to C-21; we do not consider this additional work.

Marked eight west apron positions after reading the email and RFI-118. The tender drawing referenced in the response was not available on site; our current takeoff has zero barriers here. PM asked us not to place concrete until the discrepancy is reconciled. South stair inspection passed.
